SnapshotCosmology

The cosmology from one of a snapshot .hdf5 file or of simulation class object (see swiftlet/simulations_suites.py).

Full reference

swiftlet.snapshot_cosmology.as_astropy_cosmology(cosmology)[source]

Transform to astropy cosmology object.

Make all cosmologies used consistently transformed too astropy format, handle reading cosmology as done in LightconeIO, from a hdf5 group and a Simulation object.

Returns an astropy cosmology.

Parameters:

cosmology (SnapshotCosmology, astropy.cosmology.FLRW, str or os.PathLike) – the cosmology

swiftlet.snapshot_cosmology.find_snapshot_files(snapshot_dir, pattern=re.compile('^(flamingo|colibre)_(\\d{4})(\\.\\d+)?\\.hdf5$'))[source]

Returns a list of paths, sorted by snapshot number then file name, so the lowest redshift snapshot is last.

Parameters:

  • snapshot_dir (str) – directory of the snapshots, e.g. “<simulation>/snapshots”

  • pattern (re.Pattern or str) – regular expression matching the snapshot file names, with the snapshot number as its second group (by default FLAMINGO and COLIBRE snapshot files)

swiftlet.snapshot_cosmology.neutrino_masses(cosmology)[source]

Convert SWIFT neutrino masses to astropy format.

Returns an np.ndarray of masses [eV], one per species (int(N_eff) of them).

Raises ValueError for neutrinos astropy can’t hold. i.e. degeneracies that aren’t whole numbers, or massive and massless species that don’t add up to N_eff.

Parameters:

cosmology (dict) – Cosmology attributes of the snapshot

shell_comoving_radii(redshift_filename)[source]

Comoving radii of lightcone shells from a file of their redshifts.

Returns a unyt_array [Mpc] of shape (number of shells, 2), [inner, outer] for each shell.

Parameters:

redshift_filename (str) – path of the shell redshift file

lightcone_volume(inner, outer, use_redshift=False, half_angle=None)[source]

Comoving volume of a lightcone shell between two radii, over the whole sky or in a cone.

Returns a unyt_quantity (or unyt_array) [Mpc^3].

Parameters:

  • inner (float, np.ndarray or unyt.unyt_array) – inner comoving radius [Mpc], or redshift if use_redshift is True

  • outer (float, np.ndarray or unyt.unyt_array) – outer comoving radius [Mpc], or redshift if use_redshift is True

  • use_redshift (boolean) – If True, inner and outer are redshifts

  • half_angle (float) – half the opening angle of the cone [rad]. If None, the whole sky
